# CB Antenna Install via Door Jam Mount

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

Install a door jam antenna mount kit via the rear taillight assembly. [t837]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Remove two 10mm bolts from the rear taillight assembly.
2. Carefully pop off the taillight by pulling straight back to expose the mounting area behind it.
3. [Partial] Bend the door jam section of the antenna bracket (using a hammer, vice, or pliers) to fit the available space.
4. [Partial] Position and mark the hole locations on the body panel for low vertical clearance.
5. Screw in the first bolt by hand to prevent stripping the sheet metal before tightening fully.
6. [Partial] Secure the remaining bolts to attach the bracket firmly to the vehicle body.
7. [Partial] Insert the antenna into the mount, ensuring it sits vertically.
8. [Partial] Remove a plastic cover from the 'D' pillar and pull back the rear window seal slightly.
9. Feed the coaxial cable through an incision made in the rubber gasket of the taillight opening.
10. [Partial] Reach inside to guide the cable up toward the headliner, removing any hanger if necessary.
11. [Partial] Pull the 'C' pillar trim piece back and push the cable into place within the headliner area.
12. [Partial] Reinstall the seal around the hole and secure it properly.
13. [Partial] Move down to the passenger side 'B' pillar and repeat the process of pulling back seals and feeding the wire under the carpet.

_Procedure reported by [t837]._

## Tools

- [Partial] 10mm socket or wrench [t837]
- [Partial] Hammer, vice grips, or pliers for bending bracket [t837]

## Parts

- Antenna [t837]
- Coaxial cable [t837]
- [Partial] Door jam antenna mount kit, approx 18' cable [t837]

## Tips & gotchas

- Start the first screw by hand to avoid stripping soft sheet metal. [t837]
- [Partial] Make a small incision in the rubber gasket rather than removing it entirely if possible. [t837]
- [Partial] Use a wire hanger as feeder tape under the carpet instead of reaching blindly with your hand. [t837]

## Common mistakes

- [Partial] Stripping sheet metal holes by overtightening immediately without starting by hand. [t837]
